useful_delta: Produced a scalable typed graph model for umbrella projects, durable Chat Objects, campaigns, workstreams, shared capability owners and disposable execution; defined deterministic Home/binding/discovery semantics, zero-memory friction rules, a future Assembly Surface information architecture, and a preserve-first migration path for Alumnos and Facultad. The design explicitly prevents project membership, menu position, newest workstream or public-catalog labels from becoming product authority.
facts: PROJECT_INDEX.json already defines project_id as a human-facing durable umbrella and menu numbers as temporary aliases; project-prometeo-chat-control is bound to one durable Chat Object while Facultad and Alumnos remain REGISTERED_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED.

The Chat Object contract already separates project_id, chat_object_id, workstream_id and worker_instance_id and defines a Chat Object as a long-lived operational seat rather than a transcript or whole project.
The Big Picture Map explicitly requires multi-project/multi-Chat-Object modeling and treats Assembly Surface as a future projection while ChatGPT remains the immediate frontend.
Zero-Memory Mode requires Prometeo, a Home number, a launch code and dot/Continue to be sufficient normal human commands; the human must not reconstruct prior context.
Alumnos currently references student-world-jose-recovery, pagekit-class-player-r07 and jose-study-design-20260911, but those workstreams do not represent one homogeneous ownership tree.
student-world-jose-recovery preserves Student World, subject, class, atlas/homework and shared Study identities as distinct and is closed recovery evidence rather than a live universal owner.
jose-study-design-20260911 is a durable José-specific lab frontier and is explicitly not Human Accepted, Current or Served.

pagekit-class-player-r07 is a recovery/knowledge lane around a reusable class/whiteboard capability, not the José or Alumnos product owner; it impacts classes, study, interaction and whiteboard across consumers.

The repository root projects.json uses schema prometeo.public-catalog/v1 for public product surfaces. It is a different namespace/meaning from PROJECT_INDEX.json's operational project umbrellas and must not be merged by shared terminology alone.
Current/Catalog/Lineage and shared capability owners remain external authority. A Chat Object graph coordinates work and recovery but cannot manufacture Current, Human Accepted or Served state.

candidates.title: Typed Project / Chat Object / Campaign graph

node_types.meaning: Human umbrella and Home selector root. Groups durable operational seats without becoming product authority.
Durable conversational/operational seat carrying mission, focus, method/memory pointers, work state and reincarnation identity.
Bounded multi-run objective with phases/gates/checkpoints. Sponsored by a Chat Object and potentially involving several Chat Objects. A campaign is not automatically a new Chat Object.
Durable runtime execution/coordination lane. Existing legacy workstreams can remain in place and be referenced/wrapped rather than moved or renamed.
Reusable product/runtime capability with one canonical owner; may be consumed by many projects/Chat Objects without changing ownership.
Canonical owner or authority chain for a capability/product identity, including Current/Catalog/Lineage domains.
Prepared delegated unit of work that exists before a disposable worker.
One disposable execution instance of a Work Item.
Durable evidence/candidate output from a run, awaiting explicit parent/steward consumption.
Catalog/publicly served product surface such as entries in root projects.json. Explicitly distinct from the operational project umbrella type.

edge_types: chat_object CHILD_OF chat_object only when a genuinely independent long-lived sub-seat exists
public_surface PROJECTS_FROM product/authority identity without implying operational project membership
invariants: Project membership never transfers ownership of a shared capability.
DEFAULT_ENTRY or primary Chat Object means navigation preference only, never product authority.
A workstream is not automatically a Chat Object and a campaign is not automatically a Chat Object.
Create a Chat Object only when a durable independent mission/frontier/memory/coordination seat is valuable; do not create one per page, version or transient campaign.
One canonical owner remains responsible for each reusable shared capability.
A cross-object campaign declares one sponsor/controller and one integration steward/domain instead of relying on newest-return-wins.
Graph relations are coordination/index evidence. Current, Human Accepted and Served remain separate authorities.
Operational project ids and public-surface catalog ids are typed namespaces; matching labels or generic id fields never establish identity.

candidates.title: Deterministic binding and discovery rules
rules: Fresh unbound Prometeo renders top-level operational projects only.
A numeric Home choice is resolved against the exact rendered menu snapshot and converted immediately to project_id; the integer is never durable identity.
Candidate project entry policy: AUTO_SINGLE | DEFAULT_OBJECT | SELECT_OBJECT | DISCOVER.
AUTO_SINGLE enters the only bound Chat Object directly.
DEFAULT_OBJECT enters a declared navigation-default Chat Object directly while preserving discoverability/switching to sibling objects.
SELECT_OBJECT renders a second compact human-facing Chat Object selector only when multiple meaningful seats exist and no deterministic default is justified.

DISCOVER runs durable discovery from runtime/Catalog/Lineage, aliases and declared legacy workstreams. It groups evidence into candidate operational seats instead of selecting the newest file/version/workstream.
Discovery uses wrap-don't-move migration: legacy workstreams and authority artifacts remain where they are; new project/Chat Object bindings point to them.
When durable evidence converges on one coherent seat, persist the binding without asking the human to transport old chat context.
When ambiguity is genuinely irreducible, present the smallest semantic choice between candidate seats. Never ask for an old transcript or internal workstream id.
Prometeo <launch_code> bypasses Home and resolves the prepared Work Item directly.
A bound conversation refreshes via EPOCH plus its own relevant Chat Object/packet state; it does not rescan every project on every response.

candidates.title: Minimal ChatGPT-native Home
rules: Home shows top-level human project labels plus only a short status/attention projection that helps choose, not internal runtime metadata.
Do not expose workstream ids, run ids, version numbers or authority internals in normal Home rendering.
After selecting a project, auto-route to a deterministic Chat Object whenever possible; add a second selector only for genuine multiple-seat ambiguity.
A menu snapshot is ephemeral and can be renumbered safely because durable identity is resolved immediately.
Inside a bound object, dot/Continue resumes the durable frontier and Prometeo resyncs/reincarnates rather than reopening Home unnecessarily.
Attention/unread markers may be derived projections from durable run/return/integration state; they are not manually maintained authority.

candidates.title: Future Assembly Surface information architecture
candidates.principle: The Assembly Surface is a richer projection over the same durable typed graph and authority refs. It must never become a prerequisite for ChatGPT-native operation or a second source of truth.

shows: candidate vs Human Accepted vs Current vs Served

candidates.title: Zero-memory human friction rules
rules: The human normally needs to remember only the stable Prometeo locator plus a project number, launch code or dot/Continue.
Never require the human to choose a workstream, run, return path or internal object id when a human semantic label can resolve it.
Never require copy/paste of worker results into the parent.
Use progressive disclosure: Project first, Chat Object only if needed, deeper runtime detail only on request or real ambiguity.
Do not rebuild a custom conversation frontend as a prerequisite.
Surface worker/batch status only when it changes the next useful human action or when explicitly requested.
On discovery ambiguity ask only the irreducible semantic distinction; do not ask the human to reconstruct historical implementation context.
The common recovery path should remain Prometeo -> one project choice -> continued durable seat, with no extra ceremony when entry is deterministic.

candidates.title: Preserve-first Alumnos migration
proposal: Keep project-alumnos as the umbrella project.
Candidate: create a project-level stewardship Chat Object, e.g. chat-object-alumnos-main, only if cross-student teaching/roster/shared planning has a durable independent frontier worth maintaining.
Candidate: create chat-object-alumnos-jose as the first student-specific durable seat because José already has independent long-lived recovery/design state.
Attach student-world-jose-recovery to the José seat as closed recovery evidence/reference, not as the live universal product owner.
Attach jose-study-design-20260911 to the José seat as a relevant active design frontier while preserving its explicit CANDIDATE/not-Current/not-Served authority state.
Represent pagekit-class-player-r07 as a shared capability/dependency reference for classes/study/interaction, not as a child of José and not as property of Alumnos.
Future students can receive sibling Chat Objects only when they acquire independent durable missions/frontiers; do not flatten all students into José or create a Chat Object for every class artifact.
Preserve existing workstream paths and recovery evidence; migration adds wrappers/relations rather than moving files or rewriting product owners.

candidates.title: Evidence-first Facultad migration
proposal: Keep project-facultad registered even before a Chat Object is bound, so Home does not depend on completed migration.
Do not fabricate a Facultad Chat Object or subject mapping from labels alone: PROJECT_INDEX currently has no exact Chat Object/workstream binding for Facultad.
Run a dedicated discovery pass over current runtime, Catalog, Current/Lineage and durable course/product workstreams before persisting exact bindings.
If discovery finds one coherent umbrella operational seat, candidate chat-object-facultad-main can become the navigation entry while pointing to preserved legacy workstreams.

Create child course/subject Chat Objects only when each has an independent long-lived mission/frontier/memory. Exams/partials/semesters should normally be campaigns inside a course seat, not new Chat Objects by default.

If a cross-course Facultad Digital platform exists as durable evidence, model it as a project-level/shared product capability or workstream consumed by relevant course seats rather than duplicating it into each course object.
If discovery remains ambiguous, selecting Facultad may render a compact semantic seat choice; it must not ask for an old chat transcript.

acceptance_and_falsification_tests: Fresh chat: Prometeo -> Alumnos -> José recovers the same durable José seat with no originating transcript.
Renumbering Home changes no project/chat identity or recovery pointer.
A project with one deterministic Chat Object adds no unnecessary second selector; multiple objects without a justified default do.
PageKit can be shown as a dependency of several projects/Chat Objects while retaining one canonical owner and without creating duplicated local owners.
Facultad discovery with ambiguous evidence refuses to guess from newest filename/version and asks at most one irreducible human semantic choice.
Wrapping Alumnos/Facultad leaves existing legacy workstream paths and product authority artifacts unchanged.
A campaign can span multiple Chat Objects only with explicit sponsor/controller and integration steward/domain; parallel returns do not self-promote.
The prometeo.public-catalog/v1 root projects.json entries cannot be accidentally selected as operational project umbrellas solely because both schemas use an id or project-like label.
Deleting or never building the custom Assembly Surface does not break Prometeo/Home/number/dot/launch-code operation.
Creating/changing graph bindings does not modify Human Accepted, Current or Served state unless a separate authorized authority operation occurs.
Project/Home attention can be regenerated from durable run/return/campaign state rather than a central manually-mutated aggregate.

conflicts.issue: Two different durable concepts currently use project-oriented naming: PROJECT_INDEX operational umbrellas and root projects.json public surface catalog.
conflicts.risk: A future generic graph/compiler may accidentally merge ids/labels or infer membership/authority from the wrong catalog.
conflicts.candidate_resolution: Use explicit typed references/schemas in the graph. Treat root prometeo.public-catalog/v1 entries as public_surface/catalog_item nodes, not operational project nodes.

conflicts.issue: PROJECT_INDEX currently has a primary_chat_object_id field whose word primary could be misread as authority.
conflicts.risk: Navigation preference could be conflated with canonical product ownership.
conflicts.candidate_resolution: Define it strictly as entry/default navigation semantics or evolve toward default_chat_object_id/entry_policy terminology without breaking current bindings.

conflicts.issue: Alumnos lists three workstreams directly at project level although their roles differ materially.
conflicts.risk: Flat membership could collapse José-specific state and cross-cutting PageKit recovery into one ownership tree.
conflicts.candidate_resolution: Introduce typed Chat Object and shared-capability relations while retaining the existing workstream refs as migration evidence.

unresolved: Exact Facultad legacy/course bindings require a dedicated evidence discovery pass; this scout intentionally does not fabricate them.

Whether Alumnos needs both a project-level stewardship Chat Object and student-level Chat Objects should be decided from cross-student durable coordination needs; José clearly qualifies as a candidate student seat, but the umbrella seat should not be created merely for symmetry.

The exact canonical file/schema owner for a future typed project/Chat-Object graph should be reconciled with Agent Network/runtime, authority and compaction scouts rather than invented unilaterally here.
Cross-Chat-Object campaign controller semantics should be reconciled with Campaign Controller/Planner and Steward returns before implementation.
Security/privacy exposure of project/object graph metadata should be reconciled with the Universal AI/security scout before a public Assembly Surface is implemented.
